positions.title: Physics/Astronomy Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed software, including numerical integrators, curve ﬁtting tools, and graphing utilities, to generate and analyze data from Hill's Equations, which approximate orbital motion.
• This work will ultimately help astronomers better understand when Hill’s equations are accurate enough to be used.

projects.title: GSoundAU: Sound Propagation for Professional Audio Production
projects.description: Building a plugin for Garageband/Logic that allows users to position a source and listener and hear the effects of sound bouncing around any 3D environment (using the GSound propagation library)

projects.title: Air Guitar!
projects.description:
• Users play a virtual guitar using a Microsoft Kinect.
• Strings are simulated individually, with pitch and tone controlled by fretting distance and pick-string attack.
